title: TriggerList
description: Response shape of GET /api/admin/triggers. Read-only snapshot of the in-process behaviour dispatcher (docs/006 §4) plus a rolled-up count of the DLQ. 'Last fire' is not surfaced because the registry does not record it yet — only next_run_ts (when APScheduler owns the trigger) and the DLQ tail give the operator a concrete signal today; richer per-behaviour timing lands when docs/006 §4.4's per-turn snapshot does.

triggers.description: Every behaviour registered with the in-process BehaviourRegistry, in registration order.

dlq_count.description: Total rows in eidan.behaviour_dlq. Non-zero means at least one cron/schedule firing has thrown — operator should drill in via psql or a future DLQ pane.

behaviour_id.description: Globally unique plugin-prefixed id (e.g. 'sentry:tick') per docs/006 §2.1.

plugin.description: Plugin slug derived from the id prefix. Empty string is not a valid value — every behaviour belongs to a plugin per docs/001 §5.

kind.description: Trigger discriminator from docs/001 §5.1 plus docs/006 §1 (intent:).

spec.description: Kind-specific spec as parsed by parse_trigger() — the body after the colon in the manifest.

next_run_ts.description: When APScheduler will fire this trigger next. Only set for cron / schedule kinds while the dispatcher is running; null for event / webhook / intent (no scheduled firing) and for cron / schedule when the scheduler is stopped.
